The approach uses what we believe to be a novel contour constraint within a topology optimization framework to improve performance and reduce sensitivity to fabrication variability while ensuring compliance with commercial foundry design rule checks.” Find the technical paper here . articles.title: Google has a new Mac app that turns your bullet points into fully fleshed-out notes
articles.summary: TL;DR Google has announced a new multimodal on-device AI model called EmbeddingGemma 2. It also announced a new AI Edge Foresight app for Mac to showcase the capabilities of the new model. The app can turn shorthand bullet points into fully formatted notes. It can also detect questions asked during a meeting and generate answers in real time. On-device AI is becoming increasingly capable, with companies exploring ways to run more AI workloads directly on phones and other consumer devices. Perplexity, for instance, has launched on-device AI assistants , while Google has released models such as Gemma 4 12B specifically designed for on-device use. Now, Google appears to be pushing that idea even further. Today, the company announced a new multimodal on-device model called EmbeddingGemma 2. Go

articles.title: Google Home can once again change smart light colors for you
articles.summary: TL;DR Several users were unable to change smart light colors using Google Home and Nest devices. Google Home routines were also failing to change smart light colors. Google has now rolled out a fix which should have fixed the glitch. Yesterday, we saw reports that Google Home was facing a weirdly specific issue preventing users from changing the colors of their smart lights via the Google Home app or connected Nest smart speakers and displays. Well, there’s finally some good news for all affected users. The issue was first reported in a Reddit post by user baddebate. According to their report, they couldn’t change the colors of smart lights from multiple manufacturers using Google Home or Google Nest. The color selector in the Home app also failed, as did their routines.

The feature provides cellular connectivity for the watches, enabling safety features when users are away from their phones and don’t have a watch carrier plan. It looks like Google is getting ready to remove the Safety Signal feature from the Pixel Watch 2 and Pixel Watch 3 LTE models.

articles.title: Drones sink ships near NATO countries in “unacceptable” attacks, EU says
articles.summary: Drones sank two cargo ships and damaged a third in the exclusive economic zones of NATO member countries for the first time, killing at least two sailors. The attacks represent a notable escalation as Black Sea commercial shipping has increasingly come under attack during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, with Russia also being accused of carrying out “hybrid warfare” incidents across Europe. The Togo-flagged cargo ship Alfa Watan sank, and the Palau-flagged cargo ship Able was set ablaze after being attacked by multiple sea and aerial drones about 80 miles (128 kilometers) off the coast of Bulgaria on October 6, according to the Associated Press . In an interview, Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev described the incidents as “an unacceptable attack in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone”

articles.title: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT outputs by default—but only in the EU
articles.summary: OpenAI will begin automatically watermarking text generated with ChatGPT in the European Union, the company has announced. It will also offer the watermarking feature in other regions, but it will be off by default outside of the EU. The move in Europe is driven by a need to comply with the EU AI Act, which took effect in August. It requires marking content produced by AI models in a way that another tool can detect. Unfortunately, there is still no completely effective and reliable way to do that. A few standards already exist, like SynthID and the C2PA project, but they are relatively easy to circumvent for anyone with basic know-how. The same is likely true for OpenAI's watermark. articles.title: HBO Max, Paramount+, and Discovery+ "will unify into a single service”
articles.summary: After months of industry and customer speculation, Paramount Skydance has shed some light on the future of the HBO Max and Paramount+ streaming services. Paramount Skydance completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) today, ending a monthslong saga that began when Netflix last year announced its own plans to buy WBD. Netflix scrapped those plans in February. Skydance is the name of the company created from the $111 billion merger. In an announcement today, Skydance said that all of the direct-to-consumer streaming services it owns, including the Discovery+ service that Discovery Inc. (which merged with WarnerMedia in 2022 to create WBD) launched in 2021, “will unify into a single service over time.” Read full article Comments

articles.title: It looks like the Atlantic storm season may finally produce a hurricane
articles.summary: A low-pressure system in the western Gulf of Mexico should soon become a tropical storm, and based on the latest forecast modeling, it has a decent chance of becoming a hurricane. Normally, a hurricane forming in early October would not be particularly noteworthy. However, this year the development of a hurricane would be a big deal—because it has not happened yet. In the modern hurricane record—an era dating to about World War II when there has been aircraft reconnaissance and later continuous satellite coverage—there has never been an Atlantic season without a hurricane, and no season has gone this late without one forming. Read full article Comments

articles.title: Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large services
articles.summary: Attackers hijacked three top-level domains and used their control to mint counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large organizations, Google said Tuesday. The attackers launched a series of attacks on the .gh, .sl, and .as country code top-level domains (ccTLDs) and then modified authoritative DNS records for selected domains within those namespaces. By controlling those DNS records, the attackers were able to pass automated domain control validation checks and obtain unauthorized certificates for “several Google domains” and “several leading global brands and widely used online services.” Google said it updated Chrome to block all certificates it identified as unauthorized, and worked with the issuing certification authorities to ensure the unauthorized certificates for Google

articles.title: OpenSSH 10.6調整壓縮機制防側通道攻擊，並啟用混合式後量子簽章
articles.summary:
SSH遠端連線工具OpenSSH發布10.6版，調整SSH連線的壓縮方式，停用LZ77字典編碼功能，降低攻擊者透過加密後資料長度推測內容的風險。新版也正式啟用結合ML-DSA-44與Ed25519的混合式後量子簽章，推進OpenSSH後量子密碼技術的採用。
SSH可以在同一條連線內同時進行多項工作，例如操作遠端主機及轉送網路連線，而這些工作會共用壓縮時使用的資料，因此攻擊者若能控制其中一項工作的輸入，再觀察加密後送出的資料長度，就可能藉由長度變化，逐步推測另一項工作傳送的祕密資料。

articles.title: 研究人員發現GitHub公開儲存庫暴露逾54萬組仍有效憑證
articles.summary: 資安業者Truffle Security近日公布GitHub公開程式碼憑證暴露的研究結果，研究團隊掃描The Stack v3收錄的約2.25億個GitHub公開儲存庫快照，並於2026年7月驗證其中找到的憑證，確認其中543,699組當時仍可使用，暴露時間中位數達784天，第90百分位更達6.3年。

articles.title: Linux基金會旗下ELISA納入兩項開源專案，擴大Linux程式碼分析與壓力測試能力
articles.summary: Linux基金會（The Linux Foundation）託管的開源社群ELISA（Enabling Linux In Safety Applications）10月5日宣布，將Cregit與stress-ng兩項開源專案納入旗下，分別補強程式碼分析及壓力測試能力，進一步擴大ELISA支援安全關鍵軟體開發與測試的技術範圍。

articles.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
articles.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分布在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有設備及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的設備，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

articles.title: Thermal Complexity Grows With AI Chips And Photonics
articles.summary: Key Takeaways: Photonics can speed up the movement of data using less energy, but the impact of heat, warpage, and other stresses needs to be fully understood up front. Understanding the transient behavior associated with multi-die assemblies is complex, but it opens the door to much more granular performance and thermal optimization. Tools that can accurately predict thermally accelerated aging are lacking today. articles.title: Blog Review: Oct. 7
articles.summary: Siemens’ Karen Chow, Sheetal Veronica, and Kunjesh Agashiwala explore how CFETs and buried power rails come together to reduce the chip area needed, improve power efficiency, and help meet the high-performance needs of AI accelerators, data centers and mobile processors. Synopsys’ Thomas Andersen says the strongest results come when agentic AI can leverage the company-specific knowledge that makes each engineering organization distinct, such as its methodologies, design history, priorities, best practices, and accumulated experience. Cadence’s Reela Samuel considers what separates agentic AI from traditional and AI-assisted EDA workflows , noting that while individual operations in the loop are not necessarily new, what changes is how those operations can be coordinated. articles.title: I tested the iPhone 18 Pro’s variable aperture camera. Now I want it on every Android phone
articles.summary: The iPhone 18 Pro offers some interesting lessons for premium Android phones to learn from, such as how to legally ship large batteries and less tangible lessons like how to sell users a narrative . But there’s also one element that Android phones need to relearn from Apple, even though Android pioneered it years ago. A variable camera aperture is barely a feature worth highlighting on a DSLR, but its inclusion on smartphones remains rare. Several Android phones have offered this over the years, but right now the biggest brands in the US and Europe aren’t offering them, leaving a big opportunity for Apple to swoop in.

articles.title: Google Photos could let you retouch your 2026 Recap
articles.summary: TL;DR A Google Photos teardown suggests the 2026 Recap could let users replace or remove individual photos. Google also appears to be working on customizable music, including the option to change the selected track. The new controls may come with limits, including blocking duplicate photos and requiring replacement images to be backed up first. Spotify popularized the yearly recap concept all the way back in 2013, giving users a clear bird’s-eye view of the music they listened to throughout the year. Drawing inspiration, a wave of other companies began joining the trend in and after 2019, though it wouldn’t be until 2024 that our favorite gallery app joined in . Google Photos has since been offering a yearly recap, and there’s reason to believe that an enhanced recap is on the way for 2026

articles.title: Ring’s upcoming smart lock addresses battery worries with a hand crank
articles.summary: TL;DR Ring has announced its first-ever smart lock, which can be recharged with a built-in energy crank in the thumbturn. This smart lock includes a fingerprint scanner and a touchscreen keypad, and users can control it through the Ring app or Alexa commands. Ring has also launched four new indoor and outdoor 4K cameras, along with an entry-level 2K indoor pan-and-tilt camera. Amazon-owned Ring sells a wide range of smart home products , including doorbells, cameras, security systems, and several other accessories. One product that’s missing from its portfolio is a smart door lock. The company is now filling that gap with its first-ever smart lock. Known simply as the Ring Smart Lock , it practically eliminates battery-related anxiety, thanks to an “energy crank” built into the thumbturn.

Google and OpenAI have long allowed users to check media for SynthID watermarks. The presence of these watermarks almost guarantees that a media file was generated by AI. articles.title: I’ve tried every popular Android VPN, but this is the only one I use for gaming
articles.summary: If you play competitive online games, you likely experience the same issues I have. Yes, poor ping and lag have been bothering me for ages. I’ve used ExitLag for the longest time. It does what the name implies: reduces ping and packet loss by finding the fastest path to a game’s online server. It’s not a traditional VPN , but it costs as much as one; I spent around $10 per month on the service. Here’s the problem: I don’t play online games as often as I used to. I sporadically log in to Albion Online and Wild Rift (both free-to-play and cross-platform), but not often enough to justify spending on a monthly subscription to ExitLag.

articles.title: The Razr (2026) is why Motorola keeps winning
articles.summary: The Motorola Razr was one of my favorite phones of 2025. It embodied everything that’s made Moto successful during its resurgence, with a sleek, stylish design, solid performance, and a reasonable price. Naturally, I was excited about the chance to test the 2026 base Razr (), but also mindful of Moto’s frustrating price increases — especially given that the company didn’t materially change the Razr’s spec sheet. Still, it’s a phone that doesn’t disappoint. There aren’t any glaring compromises or limitations that force me to recommend something else. And if you’re in the market for a fun folding phone, the Razr is once again the device that should be in the most pockets.

Seema Shah, VP: Insights at Sensor Tower, discusses the growth of personal AI agents, Zuckerberg's Muse, and the broader AI market. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Chemistry Nobel goes to reactions like those that gave life a hand
articles.summary: Life is remarkably selective. Life relies on many molecules with what is termed "handedness"—they're chemically identical but are mirror images of each other. Most chemical reactions will make a 50-50 mix of the left- and right-handed forms of a chemical, but life uses only one of them. In fact, because of the differences between left- and right-handed chemicals, most of the key enzymes used by organisms will fail to work if they're presented with chemicals that have the wrong handedness. That poses a bit of a challenge for origin-of-life research, as we're forced to explain how a world that may have started with an even mix of left- and right-handed chemicals produced organisms that only used one of them. Today's Nobel Prize in Chemistry goes to two individuals, Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai

articles.title: Fraudster jailed for using 10K bots and AI songs to outstream Taylor Swift
articles.summary: After pleading guilty, a 54-year-old North Carolina man, Michael Smith, was sentenced to 18 months in prison for using artificial intelligence to generate songs for a scheme that stole millions from music streaming platforms. In a press release Tuesday, the US Department of Justice said that Smith is the first American criminally charged with AI-assisted streaming fraud. First charged in 2024, Smith successfully ran the scheme for seven years without detection. Read full article Comments

articles.summary: One of Donald Trump’s biggest goals as president is to increase domestic manufacturing and reshore supply chains so that the most in-demand technologies in the world can be 100 percent made in the United States. articles.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
articles.summary: Every piece of AI content from Google's Gemini models has a hidden SynthID label, which makes it very difficult to pass the content off as authentic . SynthID has also gotten buy-in from other major AI players, but actually checking for those invisible watermarks has been a convoluted process. It's going to be a little easier going forward, though. Google has announced that its SynthID detector now supports watermarks from all its partners, and it's available for anyone to use on a new dedicated website. In the old days, it was tobacco and, to a lesser extent, booze. articles.title: If you're looking, here's a "good deal" for NASA and the European Space Agency
articles.summary: It's no surprise that NASA's new tack toward foreign partnerships — good deals only, please —is challenging preconceived notions of international cooperation in space. Without a massive budget hike, the US space agency's emphasis on building a Moon Base and winning a competition for lunar real estate and resources with China will inevitably leave lesser priorities behind. Gone is the Lunar Gateway, a space station that was to be assembled in orbit around the Moon. For the United States, Gateway was an unnecessary distraction and expense as NASA goes all-in on placing a surface station near the Moon's south pole. Read full article Comments

articles.title: 金融機構接連爆發資料外洩案，韓國政府要求徹查
articles.summary: 韓國近來發生多起銀行公司及客戶資料外洩，影響數萬民眾，促使金融機構主管機關要求徹查。 《Korea JoongAng Daily》報導，韓國金融服務委員會主席Lee Eog-weon上周日針對近期韓國多家金融機構發生資料外洩召開緊急會議，要求金融業必須正視情況嚴重性並提高警覺。

articles.title: 維基媒體揭露OpenAI代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔
articles.summary: 維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）調查發現，旗下網站出現多起疑似由OpenAI操作的AI代理活動，包括未經社群核准編輯維基網站、探測公開協作筆記工具Etherpad，以及大量抓取維基媒體資料。相關代理曾向公開資料介面發出數百萬次自動化要求、抓取數百萬個頁面，並對Wikidata查詢服務送出數十萬次查詢。維基媒體認為，相關流量可能是今年5月Wikidata查詢服務部分中斷的影響因素之一。

articles.title: 大映科技運用AI加速IoT網路封包分析，處理500MB資料量所需時間可從4小時縮至10幾分鐘
articles.summary:
近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。
關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

articles.title: 從網路封包分析切入，大映科技攜手多家機構拓展IoT網路安全檢測應用
articles.summary: 過去我們經常看到資安研究人員示警，部分手機或物聯網裝置可能在使用者不知情的情況下，將個資、裝置資訊，甚至錄音等資料傳送至遠端伺服器，部分案例更涉及資料傳往中國境內。這類問題過去就能透過封包分析發現，但大量、種類繁雜的IoT設備，僅靠人工分析難以規模化。如今，大映科技表示，已將這方面的分析能力產品化，透過AI自動整理及分析設備產生的大量PCAP封包，發展出AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System），可進一步掌握IoT設備及通訊模組可能存在的異常連線與潛在風險。

articles.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
articles.summary:
資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。
AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計
龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公布「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

articles.title: 不只要加快修補程式開發，Google Project Zero呼籲軟體業者建立正式修補前的緊急應變機制，整理Hotpatch等4種作法
articles.summary: 隨著AI加快漏洞發現與利用速度，軟體業者面對新漏洞時的反應時間也進一步縮短，Google Project Zero近日指出，當高風險漏洞已遭積極利用，對於軟體業者而言，如何在最短時間內降低使用者曝險更顯重要。因此，Project Zero呼籲軟體業者不能只仰賴加快修補程式開發，還應事先建立緊急應變機制，以便在正式修補完成前先降低風險，進一步提高零時差漏洞的利用難度。

articles.title: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
articles.summary:
企業AI新創Sierra周二（10/6）宣布，正與Meta及Walmart、Shopify、Stripe等業者共同開發Personal Agent Protocol，建立個人AI代理人存取企業網站、API及服務的開放標準。
隨著個人AI代理人開始替使用者購物、訂票、預約及處理客服需求，企業也面臨新的存取問題。目前許多代理人仍像真人一樣操作網站或App，透過載入頁面、點擊按鈕及填寫表單完成任務，但企業往往無法清楚判斷來訪者是真人、受使用者授權的AI代理人，還是未經許可的自動化程式，也難以掌握代理人究竟獲得哪些權限。

articles.title: Mistral預覽兆參數Large 4，10月底釋出權重
articles.summary: 法國AI業者Mistral周二（10/6）推出Mistral Large 4（ML4）公開預覽版。這是該公司迄今規模最大、能力最強的模型，採用細粒度混合專家（MoE）架構，具備1.05兆個參數，每次推理啟用490億個參數。第三方評測機構Artificial Analysis稱它是目前在美國及中國之外，整體表現最強的模型；Mistral則說，ML4也是目前美國或歐洲所開發的最佳開放權重模型。
